title: Glowing balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#e8345a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b8183a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glowGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff99aa' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff99aa' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow around balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='32' ry='34' fill='url(#glowGrad)'/>
  <!-- balloon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='22' ry='26' fill='url(#balloonGrad)'/>
  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='30' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#ffb3c2' opacity='0.7' transform='rotate(-20 42 30)'/>
  <!-- small highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='27' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#ffe0e6' opacity='0.8' transform='rotate(-20 40 27)'/>
  <!-- balloon knot -->
  <polygon points='46,65 54,65 50,70' fill='#c41e42'/>
  <!-- string -->
  <path d='M50 70 Q52 78 48 84 Q44 90 47 96' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
